objective: Reduce inference memory (peak RSS) on Apple Silicon without sacrificing correctness, via low-bit KV paged-attention and calibrated per-tensor quantization.

phases.summary: memopt-pipeline-w1: q8_0 K/V through TESSERA_PAGED_ATTN (CPU+Metal on-the-fly dequant, -kvu plumbing in llama-bench); fixed pre-existing broken page_map. Champion g1 -2.4 MiB RSS vs f16 baseline, correctness pass, stacked on main.

memopt-pipeline-w2: mmap-backed KV residency via LLAMA_KV_LAZY_CLEAR (skip eager buffer_clear on KV init). s2 -1.94% RSS, stacked on main. s3 (sliding-window evict) + s7 (radix cap) promoted but bench-invisible -> stack_skip. **UPDATE 2026-08-04**: wave-3's 's2 confirmed-non-repro +0.59GB' finding was refuted by agent-l on current main (see p13). The eager path's +/-15 MiB RSS stdev on a 7.5 GiB memset produces outliers that triggered the original non-repro; the lazy path is 37x more deterministic. Env-var opt-in (LLAMA_KV_LAZY_CLEAR=1) is now in main as of d7d70e33a.

memopt-pipeline-w3: low-bit KV via standard K-quant (q2_K/q4_0/q5_0) + Hadamard rotation, fused dequant in paged op. g1 -0.48% RSS but verdict partial - end-to-end paged path still broken on SWA models (q4_0 token-match 100% on flash path only). Not stacked on main.

memopt-pipeline-w4: fix v_trans mismatch (paged kernel read V non-transposed, cache stored transposed) + SWA page-map filter. qwen2.5-0.5B f16 paged 1%->100%; gemma-4-12B still 1% via separate pre-existing hybrid-iswa bug. Champion g1 stacked on main; verdict partial.

memopt-pipeline-w5: root-caused hybrid-iswa paged bug - pass v_trans explicitly to ggml_tessera_paged_attn instead of ambiguous (v->ne[0]==k->ne[2]) shape inference. gemma-4-12B f16 paged byte-identical to flash (3.8%->100%, two prompts); qwen2.5-0.5B stays 100%. Champion g1-w5 stacked on main; verdict full.

spec-consolidate: collapsed llama.dflash.acceptance.v1 + llama.spec_calib.v2 + llama.spec_calib.v3 into a single llama.tessera.spec.v1 record. --telemetry-v1-compat removed. MERGED to main as bbea981e9. Two pre-existing bugs found (test-spec-calibration assert; duplicate spec-calib paths) dispatched to findings-curator as evolve-review/bug-fixes/spec-followups (unmerged).

Workstream A (embedded-drafters): 4 drafters (MTP, DFlash, DSPark, Eagle3) targeted to embed in a single target GGUF. (a) tensor-name prefixes picked as the GGUF convention (matches existing LLM_ARCH_EAGLE3 grouping). (b) has_dft() relaxed to accept draft.target_model_path; ctor gains a 'use_embedded' branch that loads the drafter from the target GGUF. (c) test-spec-calibration restored to set target_model_path (the original author was right; runtime was incomplete). (d) imatrix dead-code (compute_imatrix_spec) removed; call site inlined to common_speculative_calibration_run with captureless-lambda observer hooks. (e) 3 TODO markers left for: ADAPTIVE scoring plug-in (Workstream B), per-drafter device placement, real 'main + 4 embedded drafters' test fixture. Bonus fix: ctor was loading params.model.path (target) instead of model_path (mparams.path) for standalone drafters - masked by the assert, fixed in passing. History rebase put the doc-sync commit where it logically belongs (after the imatrix removal, not at the tip). NOTE: this entry was lost by a `git reset --hard` mid-session and reconstructed from conversation history.

Workstream B (ADAPTIVE muxer): new COMMON_SPECULATIVE_TYPE_DRAFT_ADAPTIVE that runs all 4 embedded drafters per step and uses the verifier to arbitrate the accepted prefix (no pre-verify scoring). Architecture: common_speculative_impl_draft_adaptive holds 4 children [MTP, DFlash, DSPark, Eagle3] with a child_active[i] mask for partial bring-up. Per-step loop: 4 children draft -> 4 separate trial verifier forwards (with KV rollback via llama_memory_seq_rm) -> common_speculative_pick_best_accepted_idx (longest prefix, deterministic tie-break) -> main loop's normal common_speculative_accept does the real commit. Verifier batching: 4 separate llama_decode calls per step (tree-attention deferred as future optimization). Opt-in via --spec-adaptive; default HYBRID config unchanged. Open: full per-step e2e needs the real 'main + 4 embedded drafters' GGUF (architect-deferred); tree-attention batching is the latency win once that lands.

Workstream C (ffn_down calibration coverage): investigated the 'gap' and found it was a misdiagnosis - ffn_down is already measured by the imatrix collector via the broad 'blk.*' classification in tools/imatrix/imatrix.cpp:collect_imatrix(). Empirical verification on stories15M-q4_0.gguf produced 30 ffn_down entries (5 stats x 6 blocks), all non-zero, channel counts matching the post-gating activation width (3072 bytes = 768 F32 = feed_forward_length). Two defensive changes landed: (1) a 14-line comment at the classification branch explaining the broad 'blk.*' semantics and pointing at the new regression test; (2) tests/test-imatrix-ffn-down-coverage.cpp (581 lines) with API smoke (16 cases, no model) + end-to-end (with -m MODEL) that pins the classification and verifies the 5-stat-tensor footprint on every blk.*.ffn_down.weight. Both changes are in the spirit of 'pin the actual behavior so the next reader does not rediscover the supposed bug'.
